description:
Title: LAN Party

You are planning a LAN party for 10 friends, so the first thing you have to do is to send invitations to these 10 friends.
Next, you have to find out which games they want to play.
As soon as you have received a list of games, you can appoint a date when the LAN party is going to happen.
If 8 or more people agree on this date, you are good to continue.
Else, you have to appoint another date, until 8 people are free to join you.
While you find a date, you can find out if you have all the games your guests want to play.
If some are missing, download them.
Next, you should find out how much beer your friends will require.
If you do not have enough, buy what's missing.
After that, you can enjoy the LAN party.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Planning started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectGames" name="Collect list of games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Split planning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <!-- Date branch -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateMerge" name="Date to appoint">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateCheck" name="8 or more people agree?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateNo</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateYes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Games branch -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check which games are missing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MissingGames" name="Games missing?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DownloadDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DownloadDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Join -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date and games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <!-- Beer -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EstimateBeer" name="Find out how much beer is required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerCheck" name="Enough beer?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerNo</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerYes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerBought</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Beer ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerBought</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyLANParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LANParty" name="LAN party finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CollectGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CollectGames" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_DateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_DateMerge" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Gateway_DateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNo" name="No, another date is needed" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_DateMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${eightOrMoreAgree == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${eightOrMoreAgree == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_MissingGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MissingGames" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${gamesMissing == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MissingGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${gamesMissing == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DownloadDone" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesReady" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_EstimateBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_EstimateBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enoughBeer == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enoughBeer == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerBought" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="EndEvent_LANParty"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
